newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - French, Japanese companies bid for Taiwan's T$200 billion-plus high-speed railway project.
State-owned China Shipping Corp, Taiwan Machinery Manufacturing Corp, which reported no profits in 1996, still issuing bonuses to employees.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Vice-president Lien Chan to stop overnight in Amsterdam before returning to Taiwan from Vatican.
U.S.-made Patriot missile launcher arrives in Taiwan.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan fishing boat reported to have forced illegal immigrants to jump into sea off South Africa.
President Lee Teng-hui paves way to create second "Taiwan experience".
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan dollar jumps to reach almost eight-month high.
Industrial Development Bureau plans to impose carbon tax.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan dollar rises sharply against U.S. dollar and central bank seems to agree with trend.
Finance Ministry has sold some of its shares in state-run First Commercial Bank.
